item.title: Schuylkill County Teen Wins Fan Vote in PA Farm Show National Anthem Contest
item.description: A Schuylkill County teenager will help kick off one of Pennsylvania’s largest annual events after winning the fan-voting portion of the Pennsylvania Farm Show’s National Anthem contest. Fourteen-year-old Carly Green of Tamaqua received the most social media fan votes in the 2026 PA Farm Show National Anthem contest, “Oh, Say Can You Sing?”, earning the honor of performing live during the Opening Ceremony of the 110th Pennsylvania Farm Show. item.title: WRESTLING: North Schuylkill Rolls Past Tamaqua in Schuylkill League Division 1 Match
item.description: North Schuylkill delivered a dominant performance on Thursday night defeating Tamaqua 57-17 in a Schuylkill League Division 1 boys wrestling match at Tamaqua Area High School. Entering the meet with a 5-2 overall record and a 1-0 mark in Division 1, the Spartans controlled the match from the opening bout, capitalizing on multiple forfeits and recording several falls to secure their second league victory of the season. item.title: Mahanoy City Elks Deliver Holiday Comfort Items to Lebanon VA Hospital
item.description: Members of Mahanoy City Lodge No. 695, Benevolent and Protective Order of Elks, delivered $1,800 worth of personal comfort items to the Lebanon VA Medical Center on Thursday, December 18, 2025, just in time for the holiday season. The items were purchased through a Gratitude Grant provided by the Elks National Foundation (ENF). item.title: High Winds Cause Power Outages Across Schuylkill County Friday Afternoon
item.description: High winds that moved through Schuylkill County Friday afternoon caused power outages, leaving more than 1,500 PPL Electric Utilities customers without power as of 2:00 p.m. According to PPL outage data, a total of 1,583 customers were affected countywide, with several municipalities reporting significant outages.
